verdict.rationale: Simular's Sai is a computer-use agent that carries out plain-English tasks by operating apps on a cloud or local computer. AI-generated insights from user data is a fair question for an AI agent product, but the evidence shows only task execution, replayable skills, and approvals. Nothing documents Sai analyzing the user's data to surface insights or suggestions in-product; the community Calendar-to-Docs digest script is an adjacent automation, not this capability.
